svg.title: Monitoring and observability stack flow
svg.desc: Three metric sources feed Prometheus which feeds Grafana dashboards showing API latency, host metrics, and container stats

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What prom-client metrics does the Express server expose?')
sendPrompt('What host-level stats does node-exporter expose?')
sendPrompt('How does cAdvisor know each container stats?')
sendPrompt('How is prometheus.yml configured in this project?')
sendPrompt('How is Grafana auto-provisioned without manual setup?')
sendPrompt('What is the PromQL for request rate in the dashboard?')
sendPrompt('What is the PromQL for average API latency?')

svg.text: datasources/prometheus.yml provisions the connection on startup
